title: About Where the Folds Fall Apart
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 18 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @tsarfin_art: "The Glaistig's Hour" I found this small waterfall deep in a mossy gorge, where.... A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where the Folds Fall Apart: Landscape fine-art tableau: a compact copper-haired adult woman's inclined head, splayed collarbone-touching hand and crossing forearm rise from diagonal blush folds; a detached flared hem rests below. Broad green-black quiet separates this dominant grouping from a smaller fractured white cascade in moss-rounded dar... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Irregular copper-haired figure and continuous blush drapery silhouette, Overlapping diagonal cloth folds within the owning figure grouping, and Copper-haired inclined head, collarbone hand, crossing forearms, and continuous blush drapery.
